content: Esekiɛli u nɛɛ, Tiri, Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
n nun ɡɔɔ wuri kuo,
n nun sɔ̃ n nɛɛ, wunɛ Tiri ɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ nim wɔ̃kun ɡoorɔ mɑ ɑ kɑ bwese dɑbinu tenkuru mɔ̀. Ye Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ wee. U nɛɛ,

content.text: wunɛ Tiri, ɑ rɑ rɑɑ nɛɛ, ɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ wuu burɔ.
Wunɛn dɑm mu wɑ̃ɑwɑ sere nim wɔ̃kuɔ.
Be bɑ nun bɑnɑ, bɑ nun kuɑwɑ nɡe ɡoo nimkuu burɔ.
Mɑ bɑ wunɛn wɑsi kuɑ kɑ dɑ̃ɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ sipɛrɛ ye yɑ wee Senirin di.
Mɑ bɑ dɑ̃ɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ sɛduru ye yɑ wee Libɑnin di suɑ
bɑ kɑ wunɛn beku sɔretiru kuɑ.
Mɑ bɑ wunɛn sɛsɛnu kuɑ kɑ Bɑsɑnin dɑ̃ɑ ɡeɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ sɛɛni.
Mɑ bɑ wunɛn kitɑnu kuɑ kɑ dɑ̃ɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ buyi
ye bɑ kɑ nɑ sɑɑ Kitimun di
mɑ bɑ nu suunu donnu mɑni.
Mɑ bɑ beku ni bɑ koo nun kɑreɑ kuɑ Eɡibitiɔ kɑ wɛ̃ɛ dɑmɡii
bɑ sɔmɑ doke.
Beku ni, nu sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe wunɛn ɡidi bɔrɑ.
Mɑ bɑ bekɑ ye yɑ rɑ wunɛn kiɑnu wukiri kuɑ kɑ wɛ̃ɛ ɡɑɑdurɑɡii,
kɑ mɑɑ wɛ̃ɛ wunɔmɡii yi yi wee sɑɑ tem bure te bɑ mɔ̀ Sipun di.
Sidoniɡibu kɑ Aɑfɑdibɑ bɑ rɑ wunɛn sɛsɛnu bwie
kpɑ wunɛɡii be bɑ yɛ̃ru bo bɑ n bu kpɑre.
Gebɑlin nɔmɑn sɔm kowo be bɑ sɔmɑ ye yɛ̃ sɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃ɑ,
berɑ bɑ rɑ wunɛn wɔrusu kɔre.
Be bɑ tenkuru mɔ̀ kɑ ɡoo nimkusu kpuro,
bɑ rɑ yɔ̃rewɑ wunɛn mi bu wunɛn kiɑru dwe.
Pɛɛsibɑ kɑ Ludibɑ kɑ Putiɡibun tii bɑ rɑɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ wunɛn tɑbu kowobu.
Bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɑbu durɔbu kɑ ɡem.
Wunɛn miyɑ bɑ rɑ ben tɛrɛnu kɑ ben sii furɔ kɔkɔnu bwɛ̃
kpɑ ye kpuro yɑ n nun bɛɛrɛ doke.

content: Aɑfɑdibɑ kɑ wunɛn tiin tɑbu kowobɑ bɑ rɑ wunɛn ɡbɑ̃rɑru kɔ̃su bu kɑ sikerenɑ. Tɑbu kowo dɑmɡibu ɡɑbɑ bɑ rɑ mɑɑ wunɛn kuku yenu kɔ̃su. Wunɛn ɡbɑ̃rɑrɔwɑ bɑ rɑ ben tɛrɛnu bwɛ̃ kpɑ nu n nun bɛɛrɛ doke.
Tiri yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ wuu bɔkɔ
ɡèn mi bɑ rɑ tenkuru ko
Tiri, wunɛn ɑrumɑni bɑkɑn sɔ̃nɑ Tɑɑsisiɡibu bɑ rɑ tenkuru nɛ wunɛn mi. Beyɑ bɑ rɑ n kɑ kiɑnu nɑɑmɔ wunɛn yɑburɔ. Niyɑ sii ɡeesu, kɑ sii wɔ̃kusu, kɑ sii kpikisu, kɑ sii pɛɛrum.
Wunɛ kɑ Gɛrɛkibɑ, kɑ Tubɑliɡibu, kɑ Mɛsɛkiɡibun tii i rɑ tenkuru koosinɛ. Bɑ rɑ kɑ nun yobu kɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ ni bɑ sekɑ kɑ sii ɡɑndu kiɑru dweeri.
Toɡɑɑmɑɡibu bɑ rɑ mɑɑ dumi yi bɑ rɑ kɑ sɔmburu ko kɑ yi bɑ rɑ kɑ tɑbu de kɑ kɛtɛkunu dɔrɑm nɛ wunɛn yɑburɔ.
Wunɛ kɑ Dedɑniɡibu kɑ be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ tem bureru ɡiɑ kpuro i rɑ mɑɑ tenkuru koosinɛ. Bɑ rɑ nun wunɛn dibu kɔsie kɑ suunu donnu kɑ dɑ̃ɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ ebɛni.

Wunɛ mɑɑ kɑ Siriɡibu i rɑ tenkuru koosinɛ. Gɑ̃ɑ dɑbinɑ bɑ rɑ nun dweeri kpɑ bu kɑ nun kpee ɡobiɡinu nɑɑwɑ ni nu sɑ̃ɑ nɡe yɑkɑ bekusu, kɑ beku ɡɑɑdurɑɡinu, kɑ beku ni bɑ sɔmɑ dokeɑ, kɑ beku ni bɑ kuɑ kɑ wɛ̃ɛ dɑmɡii, kɑ nim wɔ̃kun kpee burɑnu
, kɑ kpee ɡobiɡii ni nu sɔ̃ri.
Wunɛ kɑ Yudɑbɑ kɑ Isirelibɑ i rɑ tenkuru koosinɛ. Bɑ rɑ kɑ nun ɑlikɑmɑ ye yɑ wee Minitin di kɑ pɛ̃ɛ bwese bwesekɑ kɑ tim kɑ ɡum kɑ sere ɡum sɑwɑrɑm kiɑru dweeri.
Wunɛ kɑ Dɑmɑsiɡibu i rɑ tenkuru koosinɛ wunɛn ɑrumɑni bɑkɑn sɔ̃. Bɑ rɑ kɑ nun tɑm mɛ mu wee Hɛlubonin di kɑ wɛ̃ɛ kpiki yi bɑ kuɑ kɑ yɑ̃ɑ sɑnsu kiɑru dweeri.
Sɑɑ Usɑlin di, Yɑfɑniɡibu kɑ Gɛrɛkibɑ bɑ rɑ kɑ kiɑnu nɛ wunɛn yɑburɔ. Niyɑ, sisu kɑ dɑ̃ɑ ɡɑɑ kɑ sere dɑ̃ɑ kiki nubu duroruɡisu kpɑ bu kɑ nun ye kpuro kiɑru dweeri.
Wunɛ kɑ Dedɑniɡibu i rɑ tenkuru koosinɛ kpɑ bu nun ɡɑɑri bekɑ dɔre.
Wunɛ kɑ Dɑɑrububɑ kɑ Kedɑɑn wiruɡibu i tenkuru koosinɑmɔ. Bɑ rɑ nun kiɑru dweeriwɑ kɑ yɑ̃ɑ kpɛmminu kɑ yɑ̃ɑ kinɛnu kɑ sere mɑɑ bonu.
Wunɛ kɑ Sebɑn tenkubɑ kɑ Rɑmɑɡibu i rɑ tenkuru koosinɛ. Bɑ rɑ kɑ turɑre ye yɑ ɡeɑ bo nɛ wunɛn yɑburɔ kɑ kpee ɡobiɡinu bwese bwesekɑ kɑ sere mɑɑ wurɑ.
Wunɛ kɑ Hɑrɑniɡibu kɑ Kɑnnɛɡibu kɑ Edɛniɡibu kɑ Sebɑn tenkubɑ kɑ Asiriɡibu kɑ Kilimɑdiɡibu i rɑ tenkuru koosinɛ.
Yɑ̃ɑ ɡobiɡinɑ bɑ rɑ kɑ nun kiɑru dweeri. Yɑ̃ɑ ni bɑ rɑ kɑ nɛ wunɛn yɑburɔ niyɑ, yɑbe ɡɑɑdurɑɡinu kɑ yɑbe ni bɑ sɔmɑ doke kɑ bekɑ ye bɑ sɔmɑ doke kɑ sere mɑɑ wɛ̃ɛ dɑmɡii yi bɑ tɑrɑ.
Bɑ Tiri ɡɔɔ swĩiyɑmmɛ

content.text: Tɑɑsisin ɡoo nimkusɑ su rɑ n wunɛn kiɑnu sɔɔwɑ.
Mɑ wunɛn dukiɑ kɑ wunɛn bɛɛrɛ yɑ kpɛ̃ɑ nim wɔ̃kun berɑ mi ɡiɑ.
Goo tɛmɔbu bɑ kɑ nun bɔsu nim bɑkɑm sɔɔ.
Adɑmɑ woo ɡɑɡɑ koo nɑ sɑɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yerun di
ɡu nun kɔsuku nim wɔ̃ku ɡen suunu sɔɔ.
Wunɛn dukiɑ kɑ wunɛn kiɑnu
kɑ be bɑ rɑ wunɛn sɛsɛnu bwie kɑ be bɑ rɑ bu kpɑre
kɑ be bɑ rɑ wunɛn wɔrusu kɔre kɑ wunɛn kiɑ dɔrobu
kɑ wunɛn tɑbu kowobu kɑ sere be kpuro be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ wunɛn tii sɔɔ
bɑ koo num nim wɔ̃kun sɔɔwɔ dɔmɑ te ɑ wɔrumɑ.
Be bɑ rɑ nun kpɑre bɑ koo kuuki ko
kpɑ nim wɔ̃kun ɡoonu nu diiri.
Be bɑ wunɛn sɛsɛnu bwiɑmɔ kɑ be bɑ bu kpɑre,
be kpuro bɑ koo sɑrɑwɑ wunɛn min di bu nɑ tem dirɑɔ.
Bɑ koo nɔɔɡiru suɑ
bu nun wuri kɔ̃si koosi
kpɑ bu tii tuɑ wisi winɔ
bu bindi torom sɔɔ nuku sɑnkirɑnun sɔ̃.
Bɑ koo ben winu kɔni wunɛn sɔ̃,
kpɑ bu sɑɑkibɑ dewe
bu nun ɡɔɔ swĩiyɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnun sɔ̃.
Ben nuku sɑnkirɑ ni sɔɔ,
bɑ koo nun womu koosi bu nɛɛ,
wunɛ Tiri, ɑ ǹ kɑ wuu ɡɑɡu weenɛ.
Wee ɑ kɑm kuɑ nim wɔ̃kun suunu sɔɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ ɑ wunɛn tenkuru mɔ̀ tɔn dɑbirɑ ɑ rɑ diisie.
Wunɛn dukiɑ kɑ wunɛn kiɑnun kpɑ̃ɑrun sɔ̃,
ɑ derɑ sinɑmbɑ kuɑ dukiɑɡibu.
Adɑmɑ ɑ kɔsikirɑ ɑ wɔri nim wɔ̃kun sɔɔwɔ
mɑ wunɛ kɑ wunɛn kiɑnu kɑ wunɛn tɔn dɑbi te kpuro i nim diirɑ.
Be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ tem burenu sɔɔ bɑ nuki sɑnkire wunɛn sɔ̃.
Mɑ ben sinɑmbu bɑ bɛrum soore bɑ wuswɑɑ burisinɛ.
Tem tukum tenku be bɑ koo sɑrɑ mi, biti koo bu mwɑ
kpɑ bu nun wiɑ koosi.
Domi ɑ kɑm kuɑ.
A ǹ kɑɑ n mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑ.

content: Gɑri yi bɑ ɡeruɑ
Tirin sunɔn sɔ̃
